Litepower Gen4
Reliable Power for Everyday PC Builds
Designed for everyday PC systems, the Litepower Gen4 550W delivers reliable power with 80 PLUS® 230V EU
Internal certified efficiency. Featuring a high-amperage single +12V rail, an ultra-quiet 120mm cooling
fan, and low-profile etched black cables, it provides stable power delivery and practical features for
everyday PC builds.
Ultra-Quiet 120mm Fan
Equipped with a 120mm hydraulic bearing cooling fan with intelligent RPM control, the Litepower Gen4
550W delivers excellent airflow while maintaining quiet operation for a comfortable computing
experience.
Energy Efficiency & Environmental Compliance
The Litepower Gen4 Series supports Intel C6/C7 states and Intel Deep Power Down for improved energy
efficiency. It also supports the Energy Star 5.0 energy standard and complies with EU WEEE and RoHS
directives, reflecting Thermaltake's commitment to environmentally responsible product design and
manufacturing.
Industry-Grade Safety Protections
Built-in protections including Over Voltage Protection (OVP), Under Voltage
Protection (UVP), Over Power Protection (OPP), and Short Circuit Protection (SCP) help safeguard your
system against electrical faults for reliable everyday operation.

The Litepower Gen4 550W is 80 PLUS® 230V EU Internal certified, delivering reliable efficiency under
real-world load conditions. Improved power efficiency helps reduce unnecessary energy loss and heat
